**Plan, not yet applied.**

`buildRows()` in `[report.js](src/report.js)` already returns full rows, `owner` and `slow` included. `toTable()` in `[format.js](src/format.js)` drops those two on purpose, by comment.

So `--json` should dump `buildRows()` straight through `JSON.stringify`, not go through `toTable`. In `[cli.js](src/cli.js)`, check `argv[1] === '--json'` and branch before calling `toTable`.

Next: implement that branch, unless you want it shaped differently.
